primary_assessment.label: rifampin ADP-ribosyltransferase (Arr)
locations: Results: Diversity and Distribution of arr
Results: Characterization of Arr Enzymatic Activity
Results: Crystal Structure of Rifampin-Bound Arr-ms
primary_assessment.review: Arr is a family context, not one universal allele. The paper distinguishes Arr-ms, Arr-sc and Arr-2, and deposits the Arr-ms structure as 2HW2. Its cellular comparison uses a heterologous host and does not establish native resistance in each source species. The displayed substrate headings include rifampin, rifabutin, rifamycin SV and rifaximin, not rifapentine. A structure-linked M. smegmatis reference cannot stand for Arr-sc, Arr-2, all family members or exact experimental derivatives.

primary_assessment.label: rgt1438
primary_assessment.review: JX028276 is the source-reported nucleotide deposit, not a protein or versioned assembly. Table 1 reports 16S relatedness to Streptomyces speibonae, not a verified species-level assignment of WAC1438. The study separates native-isolate drug inactivation and susceptibility effects from heterologous-host and biochemical results. Residual resistance after disruption indicates another mechanism; rgt1438 is not the sole explanation. The biochemical substrate tables include rifabutin and rifaximin, but not rifapentine. These results do not establish organismal resistance to every inherited rifamycin membership.

primary_assessment.label: rphB
primary_assessment.review: The LC231 study distinguishes a native organism, heterologous-host measurements and enzyme activity. Its WGS deposit and determinant-accession range do not specify which nucleotide accession belongs to rphB; range order is not a crosswalk. The existing LC231 taxonomy name has native species rank despite containing the word strain. Neither the species node nor a homolog identifies an exact experimental allele.
